content: विशीर्ण {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Shattered, broken to pieces; दधति विदार्य विशीर्णशुष्कदेहाः <ls>Māl. 5. 15</ls>. .²2 Decayed, withered. .²3 Dropped or fallen down; स्वयं विशीर्णद्रुमपर्णवृत्तिता <ls>Ku. 5. 28</ls>. .²4 Shrunk, shrivelled. .²5 Impaired, wasted, spoiled. .²6 Squandered (as a treasure). .²7 Rubbed off (as unguent). .²8 Frustrated (as an enterprise).
